items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Harry Gray was the President of Local 208, you know.

ctx.x: And so there were a lot of people that wanted to get into see Petrillo at that time, and Stuff had a kind of goofy -- like he was, he was loose. He wasn't a bad guy, he was just loose and would get into trouble. He would always stumble into trouble. So he knew he had to go see Petrillo, by instinct, and he went to his office and at that time we had a divided local in Chicago. Harry Gray was the President of Local 208, you know.
